changes.text: A workspace report that breaks the validation table or session-form rules of the report contract is rejected with VALIDATION, and nothing is written.
A workspace report requires write scope; a key without it gets FORBIDDEN and nothing is written.
Each report upserts its machine by alias with hostname and last_seen_at; the machine boot_id is set only by a hook report with a non-null boot id.

A hook report with a non-null boot id marks every other running or idle session on that machine whose non-null boot_id differs as interrupted with end_reason reboot and ended_at now; the reported session is never interrupted and interrupted_sessions counts the changed rows.

A report upserts the workspace by machine and path with a trailing slash stripped; omitted repo keys keep stored values and null clears them; git null clears the snapshot, an omitted git keeps it and an object replaces it; missing_since is cleared; last_activity_at is now for hook reports and the newest observed time for scan reports.

A report with a feature_id of a visible task links the workspace; an unknown or invisible id gives warning feature_not_found and a non-task gives feature_not_task, both leaving the link unchanged; an absent feature_id keeps the link; a report never creates a feature or unlinks.

Hook reports upsert the session keyed by workspace, agent kind and agent session id; start and activity set running, stop sets idle, end sets ended with ended_at and end_reason, and any non-end event clears ended_at and end_reason; id-less start inserts, other id-less events update the newest id-less session of that kind or insert one.

Scan reports insert new sessions as idle with a null boot id and started_at and last_activity_at set to observed_at; existing sessions only move last_activity_at forward and fill a null cwd or transcript_path.
Reports write audit rows only for machine_create, workspace_create, workspace_link, session_create, session_end and session_interrupt; activity-only reports write none.
No workspace report writes the entities table, changes an entity version or changes enrichment status.

The report returns the workspace object, session, sessions, feature, interrupted_sessions and warnings as defined in the report contract, with workspace and feature null when the report has no workspace.
The server setting WORKSPACE_DORMANT_AFTER_DAYS defaults to 30, accepts integers of at least 1, and is documented in docker-compose.yml, .env.example and the README configuration table.
